releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.21 — the backend address is no longer written into the app's code. It is supplied when the build is made (the same way the web app takes VITE_API_URL) and read once at start-up, so every request and the live socket still share a single source. If a build is made without an address, NChat now shows a "Connect NChat" screen and stores what you type, instead of failing quietly.
